options.content:
### Service health → distribution shift → failure detection
API metrics cover all application traffic. Evidently panels show only manifest-tracked batches for the selected model/version. Latest-run cards respect the time, mode and batch filters. **Missing labels remain unavailable.**

panels.title: 02 / Data drift · latest selected monitoring run

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
 AND model_name = ${model:sqlstring} AND model_version = ${version:sqlstring}
 AND (${mode:sqlstring} = '__all' OR simulation_mode = ${mode:sqlstring})
 AND (${batch:sqlstring} = '__all' OR batch_id = ${batch:sqlstring})
 AND $__timeFilter(calculated_at)
 AND metric_name = 'dataset_drift' ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT metric_value AS "Dataset drift status" FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name='dataset_drift'

SELECT calculated_at AS time, metric_value AS "Drifted share", threshold AS "Configured threshold" FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
 AND model_name = ${model:sqlstring} AND model_version = ${version:sqlstring}

 AND (${batch:sqlstring} = '__all' OR batch_id = ${batch:sqlstring})
 AND $__timeFilter(calculated_at) AND metric_name='share_of_drifted_features' ORDER BY calculated_at

panels.title: Selected run · label count, mode and model identity

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM monitoring_metrics WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
 AND model_name = ${model:sqlstring} AND model_version = ${version:sqlstring}
 AND (${mode:sqlstring} = '__all' OR simulation_mode = ${mode:sqlstring})
 AND (${batch:sqlstring} = '__all' OR batch_id = ${batch:sqlstring})
 AND $__timeFilter(calculated_at)
 AND metric_name = 'dataset_drift' ORDER BY calculated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1)
 SELECT calculated_at AS "Calculated", model_name AS "Model", model_version AS "Version",
 simulation_mode AS "Mode", batch_id AS "Batch", run_id AS "Run", sample_size AS "Predictions",
 (SELECT metric_value FROM monitoring_metrics labels WHERE labels.run_id=m.run_id AND labels.metric_name='labeled_predictions') AS "Eligible labels"
 FROM monitoring_metrics m WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM latest) AND metric_name='dataset_drift'
